dialogues.speaker: Zaleskaya
dialogues.text: Klimochka, it's about time we go home. It's freezing out here. If you catch a cold, you'll have to take that bitter medicine again.

dialogues.speaker: Klim
dialogues.text: Just a little longer, Mama. I'm almost done! Look, I've got "Snowman Daddy" here with me, so I'm not cold at all!

dialogues.speaker: Klim
dialogues.text: Yep! Tomorrow, I'm gonna build you and me too, Mama. Then our whole family can always be together!

dialogues.speaker: Klim
dialogues.text: Mama, do you think... Daddy can see us from down there?

dialogues.speaker: Zaleskaya
dialogues.text: Hmm, your daddy...? I'm sure he can.

dialogues.speaker: Zaleskaya
dialogues.text: After all, that bastard's gonna pass by here once he gets off work tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Zaleskaya
dialogues.text: Don't worry. If he tries to pretend he didn't see it... Mama will grab him by the collar and drag him all the way over here to look, Klimochka.
